content.text: Summary: Checked the accounts namespace and found the new 3.1.0 pod stuck not-Ready with 404s on /healthz; its logs show 3.1.0 moved health to /readyz and /livez. That failing readiness probe is what's holding the rollout, so I resolved T-2004 with a note telling the owner to update the Deployment's probe paths to /readyz and /livez.
